zh-CN.title: 语音转写更自然
items: 转文字入口移到语音气泡靠近屏幕中线的一侧，加载、收起和重试状态更清楚
转写正文以贴合续页展示，并自动适配不同聊天气泡样式

en.title: More natural voice transcripts
items: The transcript action now sits beside the voice bubble with clear loading, hide, and retry states
Transcript text now opens as an attached continuation that adapts to every chat bubble style
